metadata.warning: Weak / development labels used. Benchmarks establish baseline feasibility prior to human gold-standard evaluation.

delivery_status_tracking.name: delivery_status_tracking
delivery_status_tracking.description: Customer inquiring about the whereabouts, dispatch status, estimated arrival date/time, courier transit issues, carrier delays, or tracking updates of an order.
delivery_status_tracking.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of shipping, dispatch, tracking number, courier/carrier (AMZL, UPS, Hermes, etc.), delivery delays, package not arrived, ETA inquiries, or out-for-delivery status.
delivery_status_tracking.exclusion_criteria: Reports of physically damaged, broken, or empty boxes (classified as damaged_defective_wrong_item). Requests to cancel an in-transit order (classified as order_cancellation_modification).
likely_confusions: damaged_defective_wrong_item (when customer mentions 'package arrived broken')
order_cancellation_modification (when customer wants to cancel because of a delay)
return_refund_exchange (when customer asks for refund due to late delivery)
representative_examples: why is my order at my local courier for the last 6 days and still hasn’t been delivered to me??
Item has not been delivered but tracking says it was handed to me over an hour ago...
What's with the shipping? I order something on Saturday, and it's not arriving until Wednesday?
発送された商品の追跡番号を教えてください。
Mon colis devait arriver aujourd'hui mais je n'ai toujours rien reçu.

return_refund_exchange.name: return_refund_exchange
return_refund_exchange.description: Customer requesting to return an eligible item, check refund processing status, obtain a prepaid return label, or request an exchange/reimbursement.
return_refund_exchange.inclusion_criteria: Explicit requests for return labels, refund status, money back, returning goods, product exchange, or reimbursement for return shipping costs.
return_refund_exchange.exclusion_criteria: First-time reports of defective/damaged items without explicit return/refund request (classified as damaged_defective_wrong_item). Payment gateway errors or unexpected bank charges (classified as payment_billing_promotions).
likely_confusions: damaged_defective_wrong_item (when customer says 'it arrived broken, I want a refund')
payment_billing_promotions (when customer asks where their refund credit is)
representative_examples: I called customer service and was told my membership wouldn't be renewed. How do I get a refund?
Can I get a return shipping label? The item is still unopened.
I dropped off my return package at Hermes 5 days ago, when will my refund be issued?
返品の仕方を教えてください。返金はいつ頃になりますか？
Je souhaite retourner cet article et être remboursé au plus vite.

damaged_defective_wrong_item.name: damaged_defective_wrong_item
damaged_defective_wrong_item.description: Customer reporting that an item arrived broken, scratched, defective, non-functional, missing parts, inside an empty/opened box, or completely different from what was ordered.
damaged_defective_wrong_item.inclusion_criteria: Physical damage, defective electronics, missing pieces, shattered/scratched goods, fake/counterfeit goods, or wrong item/variant received.
damaged_defective_wrong_item.exclusion_criteria: Late deliveries where the package is intact (classified as delivery_status_tracking). Digital content playback errors (classified as prime_digital_services).
likely_confusions: delivery_status_tracking (when package is damaged by the courier in transit)
return_refund_exchange (when customer explicitly demands return rather than describing defect)
representative_examples: my package was ‘accidentally’ opened.. 4 items missing worth £97. You need better delivery drivers!!
The screen on the monitor I received is cracked and shattered completely.
I ordered size 10 shoes and you sent me size 7. This is the wrong product.
届いた商品の箱が潰れていて中身が破損していました。交換できますか？
Ihr Flaschen! Erst habt ihr mir ein Paket mit falschem Inhalt geschickt...

order_cancellation_modification.name: order_cancellation_modification
order_cancellation_modification.description: Customer seeking to cancel an existing order, stop an accidental purchase, or modify order details such as shipping address or payment method before dispatch.
order_cancellation_modification.inclusion_criteria: Phrases like cancel my order, stop order, change delivery address, cancel accidentally placed order, or cancel subscription order.
order_cancellation_modification.exclusion_criteria: Canceling an account or deleting user profile (classified as account_access_security). Canceling a Prime subscription (classified as prime_digital_services).
likely_confusions: prime_digital_services (when canceling Prime membership specifically)
delivery_status_tracking (when canceling because delivery is taking too long)
representative_examples: Please cancel order # 123-4567890-1234567 I bought it by accident.
Can I change the delivery address for my order? It hasn't shipped yet.
I tried to cancel my order online but the button is greyed out. Help please!
注文をキャンセルしたいのですが、まだ間に合いますか？
Pouvez-vous annuler ma commande passée ce matin par erreur ?

payment_billing_promotions.name: payment_billing_promotions
payment_billing_promotions.description: Customer experiencing payment transaction errors, unexpected or duplicate charges, gift card balance or redemption issues, promo code failures, or invoice requests.
payment_billing_promotions.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of credit/debit cards, bank deductions, unauthorized charges, double billing, gift cards, vouchers, promo/discount codes, invoices, or payment gateway failures.
payment_billing_promotions.exclusion_criteria: Recurring Prime subscription membership fees (classified as prime_digital_services unless purely disputing an unrecognized charge). Pure refund requests for returned items (return_refund_exchange).
likely_confusions: prime_digital_services (when customer complains about Prime renewal fee)
return_refund_exchange (when customer asks where their refund credit is)
representative_examples: where can I chat with a support member for a false charge?
when do you guys charge for the Xbox one X I preordered? It ships the 6th.
My gift card code says it is already redeemed, but my balance is still zero.
promotion code doesn’t work on checkout

prime_digital_services.name: prime_digital_services
prime_digital_services.department: Digital Devices & Subscriptions (Prime, Kindle, Fire TV, Echo/Alexa)
prime_digital_services.description: Customer having questions or technical issues with Amazon Prime benefits, Prime Video streaming, Kindle e-readers/ebooks, Fire TV hardware/apps, Echo/Alexa devices, or Amazon Music.
prime_digital_services.inclusion_criteria: Prime Video playback/buffering errors, Fire TV app crashes, Kindle syncing/page numbers, Alexa voice commands, Prime membership benefits questions, or Amazon Music subscriptions.
prime_digital_services.exclusion_criteria: General retail order deliveries even if placed with Prime shipping (classified as delivery_status_tracking). Physical damage to retail items (classified as damaged_defective_wrong_item).
likely_confusions: delivery_status_tracking (when customer complains Prime 2-day delivery was slow)
payment_billing_promotions (when customer asks about Prime membership price)
representative_examples: also, beim Addams Family-Film in Prime sind Bild und Ton nicht wirklich synchron. Wie kommt's?

account_access_security.name: account_access_security
account_access_security.description: Customer unable to log into their account, locked out, encountering OTP/2FA errors, suspecting account compromise or hacking, or requesting account closure.
account_access_security.inclusion_criteria: Password reset failures, OTP not received, 2FA issues, suspended or blocked accounts, unauthorized account activity / hacked reports, or closing/deleting account.
account_access_security.exclusion_criteria: Credit card fraud reports without account compromise (payment_billing_promotions). Simple address book changes within an active account (order_cancellation_modification).
likely_confusions: payment_billing_promotions (when customer suspects a charge was made by a hacker)
feedback_complaint_chatter (when customer vents about being blocked without giving details)
representative_examples: I want my amazon payments account CLOSED. dm me please.
Bought an Echo Show and it won’t recognize a single account in our household.
Why would Amazon hack my account? Some employee must have been in there hacking people.
Bonjour, mon compte Amazon est bloque suite a une commande, toujours rien après 24h.
パスワードを再設定しようとしても確認メールが届きません。

product_seller_inquiry.name: product_seller_inquiry
product_seller_inquiry.description: Customer or merchant asking about product availability/stock, specifications, warranty, third-party seller policies, price matching, or selling items on Amazon.
product_seller_inquiry.inclusion_criteria: Stock restock dates, product compatibility, seller authenticity/marketplace questions, how to sell on Amazon, or general pre-purchase questions.
product_seller_inquiry.exclusion_criteria: Post-purchase damaged goods (damaged_defective_wrong_item). Inquiries about orders already placed (delivery_status_tracking or return_refund_exchange).
likely_confusions: damaged_defective_wrong_item (when inquiring about counterfeit vs receiving counterfeit)
other_unclear (when question is extremely generic like 'how do I buy?')
representative_examples: I want to sell globally on Amazon. Where do I register as a seller?
When will the Nintendo Switch be back in stock on Amazon?
Are items sold by third-party sellers covered by the A-to-Z guarantee?
Amazonとかで物買ったことある人いますか？いたら買い方教えてほしいです
Ce produit est-il compatible avec les ordinateurs sous Windows 10 ?

feedback_complaint_chatter.name: feedback_complaint_chatter
feedback_complaint_chatter.description: Customer expressing generic brand sentiment, dissatisfaction, compliments, gratitude, social media banter (e.g. pets playing in Amazon boxes), promotional quiz contests, or broad feedback.
feedback_complaint_chatter.inclusion_criteria: Generic rants ('worst customer service ever!'), praise ('thank you for your help!'), social memes, box photos, app quiz inquiries (#AmazonAppQuiz), or general opinions without transactional issue.
feedback_complaint_chatter.exclusion_criteria: Actionable reports with order numbers, tracking issues, or refund requests (routed to respective operational intent). Empty or uninterpretable single-word noise (classified as other_unclear).
likely_confusions: other_unclear (distinction between generic sentiment vs complete lack of context)
account_access_security (when venting about account block without account details)
representative_examples: thank you for your help. Got my thing done within a day. really appreciate it 👍
AMAZON IS THE WORST COMPANY EVER, UNTRAINED AGENTS AND USELESS CHATBOTS!

#OnePlus5TAppQuiz @AmazonHelp where is a OnePlus5t winner list
Geil!!! xD Danke womit habe ich diese Ehre verdient? 😂

other_unclear.name: other_unclear
other_unclear.description: Inbound messages that lack sufficient information to determine intent without further context, such as greetings, isolated follow-up fragments ('yes', 'DM sent', '__email__'), or uninterpretable noise.
other_unclear.inclusion_criteria: Isolated greetings ('hi', 'need help'), isolated email addresses or phone numbers, fragmented replies in multi-turn threads, or unclassifiable queries.
other_unclear.exclusion_criteria: Any query containing unambiguous keywords matching the 9 operational intents above.
likely_confusions: feedback_complaint_chatter (when message is a vague complaint vs purely unclear)
representative_examples: hi I need Help
__email__
Yes, I already replied to your DM.
Please check
ok
